jobs.program: Summer Clerkship 2027/28 recruitment cycle (NSW Clerkship Recruitment Program)
jobs.notes: Open date is confirmed on the Law Society page (9:00am AEST, Wed 9 June 2027) and offers can be made from Wed 8 September 2027, but the page lists two alternative closing dates (Sunday 4 and Sunday 11 July 2027) depending on the employer, so a single close date cannot be confirmed; eligibility is penultimate-year students, with exceptions at each firm's discretion.

jobs.program: Graduate Program 2027 recruitment cycle (NSW Graduate Recruitment Program, market offers)
jobs.notes: Official page lists market-offer dates as applications open Monday 22 February 9:00am AEST, close Sunday 4 April 11:59pm AEST, interviews from Tuesday 27 April, offers from Wednesday 2 June and acceptance by 1:00pm Thursday 3 June — the weekdays match the 2027 calendar, but the page states the days without printing the year, so confirm the year directly with the Law Society before relying on it.
